context: Mei comforts Aoi after a rough day.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ひどい/逃げ/ほんとう/聴く/ブルー) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今日、ほんとうにひどい一日だったの。
lines.en: Today was really a terrible day.
lines.style: tired barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客さんに、ひどく怒られちゃって。
lines.style: downcast barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それは、気分がブルーになるね。
lines.en: That would put you in a blue mood.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 逃げ出したい気分だったよ。
lines.style: honest barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 逃げてもいいの。無理しないで。
lines.en: It's okay to step away. Don't push yourself.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ほんとう、聴いてくれてありがとう。
lines.style: grateful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ブルーな日も、明日は晴れるよ。
lines.en: Even on blue days, tomorrow will clear up.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
